name: Sikalastic-100 EP Primer
paste:
SIKALASTIC®-100 EP PRIMER: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer, April 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/sikalastic-100-epprimer.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer is a two component, 100% solids epoxy primer designed for use with various Sikalastic® membrane systems. Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer is low viscosity and promotes substrate penetration to provide excellent adhesion in demanding applications.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer can be used in the following applications:
    - Primer for concrete substrates
    - Primer for cement screeds
    - Primer for epoxy screeds
    - Patching compound/mortar
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Solvent free epoxy primer for use with Sikalastic® membrane systems
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates. AS4020:2018- Approved for use in contact with potable drinking water
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS4020:2018: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very low odour/ Low VOC
    - Low viscocity
    - Excellent substrate penetration
    - Fast curing
    - Good chemical resistance
    - Can be accelerated with Sikafloor® Booster
    - Can be used as a primer with Sikalastic® 487/488/777/888
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Density: 1.1kg/Litre
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Tensile adhesion strength: 12MPa approx.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Part A: 20kg Part B: 10kg (30kg kit)
    - Shelf life: Stored in original sealed containers within the temperature range of +5 to +35 degress C, this product will keep for a minimum of 3 years
    - Storage conditions: The packaging must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 2:1 (Part A: Part B) by volume and mass
    - Consumption: Primer: 5-6m2 per Litre approx. (CSP profile 2-3); 2-3m2 per Litre approx. (CSP profile 4-5); Patching compound: Between 1:5 - 1:8 (mixed litre of Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer: kg of blended silica sand)
    - Pot Life: 10°C- 30min; 20°C- 20min
    - Waiting time to overcoating: 10°C- 15 hours; 20°C- 8 hours; All membrane applications should be applied within a maximum 36-48 hour time period depending on temperature/UV exposure
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not apply Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer on substrates with rising moisture.
    - Freshly applied Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer should be protected from damp, condensation and water for at least 24 hours.
    - For external applications, apply on a falling temperature. If applied during rising temperatures “pin holing” may occur from rising air.
    - The incorrect assessment and treatment of cracks may lead to a reduced service life and reflective cracking.
    - Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer patching compound is not suitable for frequent or permanent contact with water unless sealed.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5°C min. / +30°C max.
5.3 Relative air humidity. 80 % r.h. max.
5.4 Substrate moisture content. Max. 4% moisture content
5.5 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - Do not apply Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer on substrates with rising moisture.
    - For external applications, apply on a falling temperature. If applied during rising temperatures “pin holing” may occur from rising air.
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer, April 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/sikalastic-100-epprimer.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikalsatic 100 EP Primer Part B, version 26/08/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/SDS%20Sikalastic%20-%20100%20EP%20Primer%20Part%20B%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikalastic 100 EP Primer Part A, version 26/08/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/SDS%20Sikalastic%20-%20100%20EP%20Primer%20Part%20A%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikalastic®-100 EP Primer Part A, version 24/05/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sds-sikalastic-100epprimerparta.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical product, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Mixing. 2:1 mix ratio (Part A: Part B) mixed for a minimum of 2 minutes
6.4 Ecology, health and safety - Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools and application equipment with Thinner C immediately after use. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.
6.5 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.6 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.7 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
